site.sitedescription: Sphagnum moor occupying a volcanic crater on the southeast slope of Mt. Torokawa in the Chugoku Mountains. Fen vegetation dominated by Sphagnum, Ilex crenata, and Carex dispalata. Upland vegetation is secondary forest dominated by Castanea crenata, Quercus serrata, and Pinus densiflora.
